_about: RasQberry LED layout registry. Each named layout describes a logical width x height matrix composed of one or more physical panels. The 'panels' array order IS the wiring/chain order: panel 0 occupies chain indices [0, w*h), panel 1 the next block, and so on. Within a panel, pixels are addressed by a serpentine walk defined by 'serpentine' (which axis is stepped) and 'start' (which corner holds the panel-local index 0). Optional per-layout 'y_flip': true flips the logical y axis (y -> height-1-y) before mapping, for physically upside-down matrices (decision D4: y_flip lives in the layout, not the environment). LED count is DERIVED as the sum of panel w*h - do not hardcode it.

single-24x8.description: Single 24x8 column-serpentine panel (the default RasQberry matrix). Reproduces the legacy 'single' mapper with LED_MATRIX_Y_FLIP=true baked in, so existing hardware behaves unchanged.

quad-2x2-12x4.description: Four 12x4 panels arranged 2x2 to form a 24x8 logical matrix. Reproduces the legacy 'quad' mapper (map_xy_to_pixel_quad) EXACTLY - backward compatibility of the physical rendering is a hard requirement.
quad-2x2-12x4.note: Actual chain order derived from the legacy arithmetic is bottom-left -> bottom-right -> top-right -> top-left (indices 0-47, 48-95, 96-143, 144-191). The bottom row is wired left-to-right, then the top row is wired right-to-left, producing a continuous boustrophedon. The older 'TL->TR->BR->BL' comment in the code/env did not match the arithmetic.

quad-4x12.description: Four 4x12 LED panels, each physically mounted 12 wide x 4 tall, tiled 2x2 into a 24x8 landscape matrix. This is the CANONICAL quad mounting used in the 3D-printed RasQberry model, measured on the Pi 4 test rig 2026-07-13. Chain order TL -> TR -> BR -> BL (idx 0-47 top-left, 48-95 top-right, 96-143 bottom-right, 144-191 bottom-left). All panels column-serpentine. The two TOP panels start top-left (chain advances rightward, first column descending); the two BOTTOM panels start BOTTOM-right (chain advances leftward, first column ascending), so the chain boustrophedons back along the lower half. Anchors: idx0=(0,0), idx48=(12,0), idx96=(23,7), idx144=(11,7). No y_flip: the measured origin is already top-down.
quad-4x12.note: Re-probed 2026-07-13: the two bottom panels start at their LOWER-right corner (an earlier 'top-right' reading was a blue-diffuser artifact, refuted). With that correction this preset equals the legacy 'quad-2x2-12x4' EXACTLY y-flipped (cross-checked by unit test) - two independently-derived maps agreeing confirms the geometry. Kept as a distinct top-down canonical preset per decision D-D rather than a y_flip flag on the legacy entry.

triple-8x8.description: Three 8x8 modules placed side by side to form a 24x8 logical matrix, per-module column-serpentine, chained left to right.
triple-8x8.credit: adapted from barkol/rasqberry-3x8x8-led-adaptation (#261), chain order to be confirmed

single-8x32.description: Single 32-wide x 8-high column-serpentine panel (256 LEDs), used on the Pi 5 test rig.
